package module

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/usecase/relationorder"
)

// AddModuleSectionInput contains a module-section relation.
type AddModuleSectionInput struct {
	ModuleID  string
	SectionID string
	Order     int
}

// AddModuleSection links an existing section to a module.
type AddModuleSection struct {
	Modules        repository.ModuleRepository
	Sections       repository.SectionRepository
	ModuleSections repository.ModuleSectionRepository
	Tx             repository.TransactionManager
}

func (uc AddModuleSection) Handle(ctx context.Context, in AddModuleSectionInput) error {
	if in.ModuleID == "" || in.SectionID == "" {
		return domain.ErrValidation
	}
	run := func(fn func(ctx context.Context) error) error {
		if uc.Tx != nil {
			return uc.Tx.WithTx(ctx, fn)
		}
		return fn(ctx)
	}
	return run(func(ctx context.Context) error {
		if _, err := uc.Modules.Get(ctx, in.ModuleID); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if _, err := uc.Sections.Get(ctx, in.SectionID); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		return uc.ModuleSections.Add(ctx, in.ModuleID, in.SectionID, in.Order)
	})
}

// DeleteModuleSection removes a module-section relation without deleting the section.
type DeleteModuleSection struct {
	Modules        repository.ModuleRepository
	Sections       repository.SectionRepository
	ModuleSections repository.ModuleSectionRepository
	Tx             repository.TransactionManager
}

// ReplaceModuleSections atomically replaces the complete ordered section set
// of one module.
type ReplaceModuleSections struct {
	Modules        repository.ModuleRepository
	Sections       repository.SectionRepository
	ModuleSections repository.ModuleSectionRepository
	Tx             repository.TransactionManager
}

func (uc ReplaceModuleSections) Handle(ctx context.Context, moduleID string, items []domain.CatalogRelationOrder) error {
	moduleID, items, err := relationorder.Normalize(moduleID, items)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	run := func(fn func(context.Context) error) error {
		if uc.Tx != nil {
			return uc.Tx.WithTx(ctx, fn)
		}
		return fn(ctx)
	}
	return run(func(ctx context.Context) error {
		if _, err := uc.Modules.Get(ctx, moduleID); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		for _, item := range items {
			if _, err := uc.Sections.Get(ctx, item.ChildID); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
		return uc.ModuleSections.ReplaceByModule(ctx, moduleID, items)
	})
}

func (uc DeleteModuleSection) Handle(ctx context.Context, moduleID string, sectionID string) error {
	if moduleID == "" || sectionID == "" {
		return domain.ErrValidation
	}
	run := func(fn func(ctx context.Context) error) error {
		if uc.Tx != nil {
			return uc.Tx.WithTx(ctx, fn)
		}
		return fn(ctx)
	}
	return run(func(ctx context.Context) error {
		if _, err := uc.Modules.Get(ctx, moduleID); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if _, err := uc.Sections.Get(ctx, sectionID); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		return uc.ModuleSections.Delete(ctx, moduleID, sectionID)
	})
}
